commit.message:
Prevent brushing from propagating to reordering

Prior to d3 v3.2.2, the brushstart event would automatically call d3.event.stopPropagation(). When using d3 v3.2.2+ with a plot that's brushable and reorderable, the axes can be reordered while brushing. This change preserves the original behavior.

Merge pull request #27 from seanparmelee/master

implemented brushReset

Improved renderQueue performance

doFrame() needs to return true to stop the d3.timer. Also, a new timer was created on each call to doFrame() which slows the animation down as it processes the queue.
